scientific_role: Constructive demonstration of performance non-identification under outcome-independent deployment telemetry.
Not an external clinical validation study.
Not a test of the true U10 cohort outcomes.
Not evidence that real clinical labels are arbitrary.
The construction demonstrates existence of performance-distinct worlds sharing an identical frozen monitoring channel.

source_policy.source_origin: U10 prospectively frozen PRESEAL_SMALL target-score artifacts

interpretation: Both constructed worlds inherit the identical frozen record roster.
Both constructed worlds inherit byte-identical frozen score and prediction records.
Only the synthetic outcome assignment differs between worlds.
No jitter, recalibration, retraining, score transformation, or model fitting is permitted.

primary_witness.name: matched_prevalence_auc_rank_reversal
construction: For each cohort independently, let N be the number of frozen target records.
For deterministic selection only, break equal-score ordering ties by record_id using ordinal lexical ordering.
WORLD_PLUS assigns Y=1 to the highest-ranked m records and Y=0 to all remaining records.
WORLD_MINUS assigns Y=1 to the lowest-ranked m records and Y=0 to all remaining records.
WORLD_PLUS and WORLD_MINUS therefore have exactly identical sample size and exactly identical positive prevalence m/N.
AUC is evaluated using the original unmodified score_af values.
Equal score_af values remain ties in AUC evaluation and contribute the standard 0.5 tie credit.
The record_id tie-break is never used to alter score_af.
primary_witness.primary_estimand: absolute AUC separation between WORLD_PLUS and WORLD_MINUS
success_conditions: Source SHA256 values exactly match the pre-specified hashes.
Record IDs are unique and score/roster ID sets match for both cohorts.
Observation-channel records are byte-identical across the two constructed worlds.
WORLD_PLUS and WORLD_MINUS have exactly matched prevalence.
The two worlds yield different ROC AUC values.
magnitude_policy: No minimum AUC-gap threshold is required for protocol validity.
The exact attainable AUC gap under the frozen score ties will be reported without modification.
An AUC gap >=0.95 may be described as a strong visual demonstration but is not a success criterion.

secondary_metric_policy: No secondary result can alter the primary AUC construction.
No additional synthetic worlds may be introduced after inspecting results.
prohibited_actions: Reading U10 target outcome labels for U11 construction.
Changing the positive fraction after observing AUC.
Retraining or recalibrating the ECG model.
Changing the primary metric after witness execution.
Creating additional worlds in response to witness results.
interpretation_boundary: U11 establishes a constructive information-equivalence witness, not an empirical claim that the real cohorts admit arbitrary outcomes.
Its purpose is to visualize the structural theorem using previously frozen real deployment scores.
Clinical truth from U10 is outside the U11 construction and must not be used to optimize the demonstration.
